Added comments for logical methods in the Transaction Class. Type declarations are pretty much self-explanatory, as well as encoders because they follow the CBOR specification and doesn't have any logic.
We will continue to add more comments as we add new methods or upgrade existing methods, to gradually improve the codebase. 
Github PR - https://github.com/StricaHQ/typhonjs/pull/38
